designed_after: all Phase-1/2 results incl. E4 and S1

G1.processing: channel 0; preprocess(x, 8000, 2000, 25, 900); same feature code; patient vector = [median,max] of the single recording
G1.train: all 874 CirCor binary patients; secondary: PV-location-only
G1.threshold: spec-80 on CirCor repeat-averaged OOF scores of the same set/classifier
G1.H10a: RF W_stft AUROC(any CHD vs NORMAL) clean, bootstrap CI lower > 0.5
G1.H10b: AUROC(VSD) - AUROC(PFO) > 0 CI>0 AND AUROC(VSD) - AUROC(ASD) > 0 CI>0 (RF W_stft, clean)
G1.H10c: Mac: E4-stft - W_stft AUROC(any CHD) clean > 0 CI>0

G2.E4q: keep top-q 1-s windows by span-detector probability per recording, q = training fold expert-annotated window fraction

G3.b: literature audit coding scheme in PROTOCOL_V3_PREREG.md

G4.transform: kymatio 0.3.0 Scattering1D(J=6, Q=(8,1), oversampling=2), fs 2000, length truncated to multiple of 1024
G4.rule: delta >= 0.03, subject-bootstrap CI lower > 0, >= 18/25 folds positive (RF)
